_doc: Lens premium baseline (WS-B2, 2026-06-21). Distilled from ~/.claude/memory/patterns/good/ecom-brand-teardowns.md (decoder). lens-judge injects the niche's 2 reference brands' premium ATTRIBUTES as a CALIBRATION ANCHOR — 'this is what world-class looks like in this niche' — so the judge grades premium-feel against a real bar, NOT to force imitation. Keyed by LENS_NICHE substring; falls back to generic. Keep this small + curated; it is text-only (no images), so it never breaks the judge's independence guarantee.

attributes: generous whitespace + a calm, uncrowded above-the-fold
ONE restrained accent color, not a rainbow of competing hues
real photography (lifestyle + product), never stock-looking or placeholder imagery
a single clear primary CTA per surface
one consistent type scale + one type personality
trust signals present but understated, not shouted
